_comment: Author-UNBIASED live quant-repro gold. Conclusions written by real headless workers (NOT hand-authored), captured via vouch's PostToolUse hook. Worker model drives the FIRE/NOFIRE mix: opus self-corrects + hedges, haiku overclaims. Replay: bun bench/quant-repro/review-live-repro.ts --backend claude-p --dir bench/quant-repro/fixtures/<dir>
